name: liteboard-root
description: LiteBoard root project to manage frontend and server concurrently

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix schemav-frontend && npm install --prefix schemav-server
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n "server,frontend" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm run dev --prefix schemav-server" "npm run dev --prefix schemav-frontend"
